errors.description: The request syntax, headers, parameters, or schema are invalid.
No valid QA Hub user or scoped machine identity was supplied.
The webhook signature or replay-window timestamp is invalid.
The authenticated actor lacks the required project role or machine scope.
The resource does not exist or is hidden by the cross-project disclosure policy.
The request, evidence item, or aggregate evidence quota is exceeded.
The requested state transition is not valid from the current state.
A non-superseded active repair attempt already exists for the Bug.
The idempotency key was previously used with a different canonical payload.
An external event or delivery identifier was replayed with a different body hash.
The expected aggregate version is stale; no concurrent change was overwritten.
A domain guard such as verification, separation of duties, or exact build identity failed.
Upload size, chunk, hash, MIME, magic, scan, quota, or binding validation failed.
The actor or source exceeded the configured endpoint rate limit.
Relay delivery is missing pushed/verified proof or commitSha differs from remoteSha.
Build provider, job, project, branch, mode, or full source SHA does not match the eligible repair.
A machine identity attempted a human-only Bug decision such as verification or closure.
An unexpected server failure occurred without exposing sensitive internals.
The process is live but a required dependency or migration is not ready.
